raw_result.note: probe's on-page summary at capture time; superseded below by an OLS trend fit that excludes warmup, computed offline against the same bucket array

offline_analysis.method: OLS trend fit vs elapsed time, first 8 buckets (~16s) excluded as pipeline warmup
offline_analysis.verdict: essentially flat (+2.4%/min is within sampling noise, not a real trend); the earlier spread-based plateau check flagged this run as 'not plateaued' at 8.76% tail spread, which conflated per-bucket dispatch-count jitter with genuine thermal decay -- fixed in probe.html to use this same OLS method going forward
offline_analysis.note: this also falsifies the hypothesis in docs/device-tiers.md that this tier shares a power budget with the CPU and throttles down over a sustained run: over 120s at N=1024 it does not decline. The earlier 75.4 GFLOPS figure (7-rep quick sweep) was warmup contamination in a run too short to get past it, not a measurement of steady state.
